scope: Complete candidate mechanical construction prescription, no native, physical edits, alternative search or fixed geometry changes. Root implements one generator; architect cross-reviews before geometry execution.
coordinates: Board-local x/y from retained candidates; d positive from feed face into gap. Global z=face_z+normal_z*d; KB entire assembly translates global z by -travel. All given boxes are closed outer solids; boolean holes/bore subtraction is explicit.

material_proposal.collets_and_fingers: Machined unfilled PEEK, grade unselected; this is a design material class, no claimed supplier tolerance or load rating.
material_proposal.frame: Machined aluminum perimeter members inside continuous machined PEEK electrical isolation sleeves; external envelopes below include sleeve1mm minimum.
material_proposal.fasteners: M1 collet through-bolts/nuts and M2 carrier support screws, fully captured insulated exterior sleeves/caps. No electrical current through hardware.
material_proposal.qualification: Grade, creep, flame/insulation/environment ratings, bond and retention loads remain unqualified; source geometry may be completed before these measurements.

perimeter_carrier.intent: Replace prior full perimeter proposal by removable topbeam only; preserve existing two-deep independent board carrier/service-guide geometry. No new enclosure receivers or PCBholes.
perimeter_carrier.fastener_geometry: Explicit M2shafts/insulatingwashers/head/nut envelopes in helper; clamp to existingtopcollars, no newframe orenclosurehole.
perimeter_carrier.loadpath: Each finger -> topbeam -> two monolithic topcollarlugs -> existing supportclamps -> retained independently supported carrier. Beam deflection, collar loads/retention remain qualification; existing service-guide clearance must be checked, not rediscovered as newsourcework.

collet_and_lug.split: Plane spanned by axisw and transverse radialn;0.20mm split gap between halves before setting. Hard compression stop preserves bore envelope; grip preload/insulation retention is qualification, not inferred from OD match.
collet_and_lug.basis: In local(x,y,d), w=(board_sign*.5933040689317951,sign_i*.5927989259019525,.5445913286478836). s=hypot(w_x,w_y); n=(-w_d*w_x/s,-w_d*w_y/s,s) points away from board and is perpendicular to w; v=w cross n lies in board plane. A=(anchorx,anchory,2). This supersedes the negative-Y radial draft.
collet_and_lug.lug: Two collet halves carry matching integral radial lug from n1.7..5.5, w stations1.0..2.5, v[-1.5,1.5], with split|v|<0.10 removed. Material overlaps own shell intentionally. Outer cylinder remains separate union, not enlarged clearance exemption.
collet_and_lug.clamp_bolt: M1x5 screw axisv centered A+1.75w+4n; shaftR0.5 v[-1.8,3.2], headR1 v[-2.3,-1.8], capturednutR1.2 v[1.5,2.3]. Dielectric capsR1.4 v[-2.6,-1.8] and[2.3,3.5]. Subtract0.55mm clearance bore through lug. All head/nut/cap envelopes included in collision checks; no inherited bare-cylinder clearance credit for these additions.
collet_and_lug.radial_revision: Astra design correction accepted by root: lug bolt axis center depth approximately6.308mm and cap minimum depthapproximately4.908mm. Allfullsolids stillrequireactualsourceclearancechecks.

fingers.construction: One finger per collet. Start P=A+1.75w+5.5n; sweep2x2mm square prism along each following orthogonal segment with complete joint cubes. Section planes normal to each segment; all corner unions include their true material boxes. Own lug attachment is intended; foreign-wire contacts never exempt.
fingers.polyline: P -> (P.x,P.y,1.65) -> (L,P.y,1.65) -> (L,5.5,1.65). L=anchorx+6 for KA and anchorx-6 for KB, both rows. Repeated same-column segments form an intentional joined carrier finger, not a forbidden foreign-carrier contact. Preserve all12 attachment branches; boolean-union only same-carrier structural solids. Last segment embeds in top carrier rail.
fingers.independent_closure_requirement: Before any pass subtract full machining/registration/retention/warp/thermal budget;0.25mm residual stillrequired. Do not claim this theoretical gap for slanted joint corners until exact solid bounds checked.
fingers.wire_avoidance_rationale: Radial departure n is perpendicular to own wire tangent and awayfromboard. Orthogonal descent begins5.5mm fromaxis; nYsign varies bywirebow. Columnlane remains KAanchorx+6 / KBanchorx-6. This is construction, not a clearance certificate; descendingfinger and allotherwires must be checked.
